package.name: cho_camera_calibration
package.description: Intrinsic calibration for the cameras on this bench: the printable target, the procedure, and the resulting camera_info files. One package so that the square size on the printed board and the --square value typed into cameracalibrator cannot drift apart, and so a calibration can be referenced by a package:// URL instead of a path under someone's home directory. Knows nothing about any robot.
